key.name: match-vendor
key.summary: EDID vendor of the target display
key.description: Three letter EDID vendor code of the display to control (Apple Studio Display: APP).

key.name: match-product
key.summary: EDID product name of the target display
key.description: Product reported by mutter for the display to control (Apple Studio Display: StudioDisplay). Empty string matches any product from the vendor.

key.name: hidraw-device
key.description: Override the auto-detected USB HID interface node (e.g. /dev/hidraw8). Empty = auto-detect.

key.name: poll-interval-secs
key.description: Seconds between checks for brightness changes made outside GNOME. 0 disables polling.

key.name: debounce-ms
key.description: Milliseconds to coalesce slider movements into one CLI invocation.

key.name: min-brightness
key.description: Clamp brightness so the display never goes below this fraction.

key.name: max-brightness
key.description: Clamp brightness so the display never goes above this fraction.

key.name: brightness-curve
key.description: Perceived-brightness exponent applied to the slider position: raw = min + position^curve * (max - min). 1.0 is linear; 2.2 (default) mimics the macOS slider, making the lower half of the slider reach genuinely dim levels. Raise it if the low end still feels too bright.

key.name: ignore-ambient
key.summary: Let the slider own the brightness
key.description: GNOME blends the laptop's ambient-light-sensor target into every brightness write, which stops an external display from reaching its dim end. When true (default) the slider position is written verbatim, as macOS does, while idle dimming still applies. Set false to let auto-brightness bias this display too.

key.name: auto-brightness
key.summary: Auto brightness from the display's own light sensor
key.description: Use the Studio Display's built-in ambient light sensor (exposed over USB by the kernel hid-sensor-als driver) to move the brightness slider automatically, like macOS. Moving the slider while enabled sets a personal offset that is kept.

key.name: als-interval-secs
key.description: Seconds between ambient light sensor readings when auto-brightness is enabled.

key.name: als-min-lux
key.summary: Illuminance reading that maps to the dim end
key.description: Ambient reading (studio-brightness als) at or below which the slider is driven to auto-brightness-min-value. The Studio Display's sensor reports roughly 16-40 fully covered and about 19000 in a normally lit room, so the scale runs well ahead of true lux.

key.name: als-max-lux
key.summary: Illuminance reading that maps to the bright end
key.description: Ambient reading (studio-brightness als) at or above which the slider is driven to auto-brightness-max-value. About ten times a normally lit room.

key.name: als-min-value
key.description: Slider position auto-brightness drives the display to in dark rooms.

key.name: als-max-value
key.description: Slider position auto-brightness drives the display to in bright light.

key.name: als-bias
key.description: Offset added to the sensor-driven slider position. Adjusted automatically when you move the slider while auto-brightness is on; the offset persists across sessions.
